map.为什么我输入的内容没进去？: Why didn't my typed text go in?
map.多半是没进插入模式：Vim 启动后处于普通模式，直接打字会被当作命令。按 i 进: Probably you weren't in insert mode: after launch Vim is in normal mode, and typing is treated as commands. Press i to enter insert mode, type, then Esc to return to normal mode and enter :wq to save and quit. Also :q! forcibly discards changes — save with :w first when unsure.
